text: Patient admitted for acute chest pain and shortness of breath. ECG showed sinus tachycardia. Troponin levels borderline elevated. Discharged on Beta-blockers.
Chest X-Ray 2 Views: Mild cardiomegaly noted. Lungs are clear of acute infiltrates. No pneumothorax.
Follow-up for poorly controlled Type 2 Diabetes. HbA1c elevated at 9.2%. Patient reports mild peripheral neuropathy in feet.
